en: No, I'm not here looking for work.
Oh, and what can I do for you this time?
Ah, welcome! Good of you to come.
Why not rest a while and have a chat?
It's packed every day. They're all jobless.
They want to work but can't find a job.
They're poor, with no way to earn money.
Helping people like them is what I do.
This work gives my life real meaning.
Good of you to drop by again today.
And my work is going nicely today, too.
A factory sent us a big batch of openings.
I was able to place a lot of people in them.
I'm truly glad. What a relief it is.
Ah, welcome. How good of you to come.
To think you'd come even with no business.
I can't leave here while I'm working, you see.
Seeing you makes a nice change of pace for me.
Work isn't everything in life, but
we all have to work to make a living.
Yes, yes. Who is it?
Hm? Are you someone looking for work?
I'm surprised you found your way here.
I'm sorry, but please go to the agency.
My name is Luke. Pleased to meet you.
If it's about work, I'll hear you out there.
Yes, yes?
Oh, it's you.
I'm busy now, so please come back later.
Are you selling something door to door?
<No>
<That's right>
Oh dear, my apologies.
I was sure you'd come to sell me something
So you came to say hello. Thank you kindly.
I see, so that's how it is.
So that's why you often visit the agency, too.
But we don't need anything here, thank you.
Oh, what is it?
I'm sorry, but we don't need anything here.
You're not here to sell today, are you?
Still, I do think yours is a hard job.
I can't help directly, but I'm rooting for you.
If anything comes up, I'll be glad to help.
Do take good care of your health.
In any line of work, your body is your capital.
Ah, good morning.
It's embarrassing, but I'm a little short on sleep.
What line of work are you in?
I see. That does sound hard.
Ah, young man, you look tired.
Good evening. Well, something like that.
I've been walking all day, you see.
I see. It's a hard world we live in.
<Quite well>
<Actually, I'm out of work>
If I can be of any use, please let me help you.
Hello. But I'm not looking for work.
No, actually, that's not it either.
I just stopped by to have a look
You might find a job you like.
Do drop by again whenever you like.
Good day to you. Why, it's you
Oh? Then are you here for an employer?
You may find a job that suits you.
<No, I'm not>
<Yes, it's my job>
Is there anything I can help you with?
Hard workers and idlers alike
all of my helpers work well for me.
So this is how it should be.
Luke
Would you ask the people who have no work
to come and serve as my helpers?
Is this really the right thing to do?
Now,
Command me as you will...
Ow, ow, ow...
Did I fall out of bed in the night?
, my master... as you command...
